# Create a scatterplot of rejection volume and rejection rate by port of entry
    Find the median of each and plot them as horizontal and vertical lines to create quandrants on the graph.

```{r access rejection data and calculate median}
rejection_rates_rds_path <- here("data", "processed", "rejection_rates.rds")

rejections_volume <- readRDS(rejection_rates_rds_path)

# convert rejection rate to percent
rejections_volume <- rejections_volume |> mutate(rejection_rate = rejection_rate * 100)

# summarize by port of entry but maintaining variance across year within each port
rejections_volume_summ <- rejections_volume |> group_by(port) |> summarise(
  rejections_sem = sd(rejections, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(rejections))),
  rejection_rate_sem = sd(rejection_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(rejection_rate))),
    rejections = mean(rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    rejection_rate = mean(rejection_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
)

# gatehr median values for quadrant drawing on plots
median_rejection_volume <- median(rejections_volume$rejections, na.rm = TRUE)
median_rejection_rate <- median(rejections_volume$rejection_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Attach formal port names and longitudes to the data

```{r attach port names and longitudes}
# Load port names and longitudes
port_names_longitudes <- readxl::read_excel(here("data", "raw", "port of entry reference table.xlsx"))

rejections_volume_summ <- rejections_volume_summ |> left_join(port_names_longitudes, by = "port")
```


```{r plot rejection volume and rate}
x_vals <- rejections_volume_summ$rejections
y_vals <- rejections_volume_summ$rejection_rate

x_max <- max(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(y_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(y_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

# Start x-axis above zero to avoid compressing the points.
x_lower <- 250
x_breaks <- sort(unique(c(500, 1000, pretty(c(500, x_max), n = 5))))
x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks >= 500]

# Quadrant label anchor points (offset from median lines).
x_left_label <- (x_lower + median_rejection_volume) / 2
x_right_label <- (median_rejection_volume + x_max) / 2
y_low_label <- (y_min + median_rejection_rate) / 2
y_high_label <- (median_rejection_rate + y_max) / 2

quadrant_labels <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(x_left_label, x_right_label, x_left_label, x_right_label),
  y = c(y_high_label, y_high_label, y_low_label, y_low_label),
  label = c(
    "Low rejection volume,\nhigh rejection rate",
    "High rejection volume,\nhigh rejection rate",
    "Low rejection volume,\nlow rejection rate",
    "High rejection volume,\nlow rejection rate"
  )
)

rej_volume_rate_plot <- ggplot(rejections_volume_summ, aes(x = rejections, y = rejection_rate, color = lon)) +
#   geom_rect(
#     inherit.aes = FALSE,
#     aes(xmin = x_lower, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
#     fill = "gray90",
#     color = NA,
#     alpha = 0.6
#   ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = rejections,
      xend = rejections,
      y = rejection_rate - rejection_rate_sem,
      yend = rejection_rate + rejection_rate_sem
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = rejections - rejections_sem,
      xend = rejections + rejections_sem,
      y = rejection_rate,
      yend = rejection_rate
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = name),
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "gray60",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_rejection_volume, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median_rejection_rate, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_text(
    data = quadrant_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray35",
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ","),
    limits = c(x_lower, NA)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno", begin = 0.25, end = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "Rejection volume vs rejection rate by port of entry and year",
       x = "Mean yearly rejection volume (# of cattle)",
      y = "Mean yearly rejection rate (%)",
      color = "Longitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
rej_volume_rate_plot
```


```{r save rejection volume and rate plot}
rej_volume_rate_fig <- here("outputs", "figures", "rejection_volume_vs_rate_by_port.png")
ggsave(rej_volume_rate_fig, plot = rej_volume_rate_plot, width = 8, height = 6)

```
